name: pageread
description: read pages into traces: otel-semconv microdata, signal-routed live DOM, content-store backends, reactive indexers, bespoke browser extensions
author: rektide de la faye

scripts.build: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run build:extension && pnpm --filter @pageread/extension-build verify
scripts.check:lint: oxlint schema signals store indexer extension-kit extension-build extensions harness
scripts.check:fmt: oxfmt --check schema signals store indexer extension-kit extension-build extensions harness package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json
